financeManagementDescription: Manage invoices, income, expenses, consultant balances and company results.
consultantFinanceDescription: Review your earnings, spending and remaining balance.
consultantTransactionsDescription: Review your income and expenses month by month.
vatSettlementsDescription: Record VAT payments without changing income, expenses or profit, and retain a reversible payment history.
recordVatPaymentDescription: Record a payment that reduces the outstanding VAT liability. This does not create an expense.
noVatSettlements: No VAT payments have been recorded yet.
reverseVatPaymentDescription: The payment will remain in history and its amount will be restored to VAT payable.
financeError_noVatPayable: There is no positive VAT liability to pay.
financeError_vatSettlementExceedsPayable: The payment cannot exceed the current VAT payable amount.
financeError_vatSettlementNotFound: The VAT payment could not be found.
financeError_vatSettlementAlreadyReverse: This VAT payment has already been reversed.
vatPayableHistoryDescription: Output VAT on income adds, input VAT on expenses subtracts and VAT payments reduce what is owed, in date order.
outstandingInvoicesDescription: Invoiced amounts that are not paid yet, excluding VAT.
companyOutstandingInvoiceShareDescriptio: Invoiced amounts that are not paid yet, with the part the company keeps after the consultant's share.
consultantBalanceHistoryDescription: Consultant share of paid invoices and credited income, minus consultant-funded expenses, in date order.
earnedShareHistoryDescription: Credits to your balance, such as your share of paid invoices, in date order.
spentFromBalanceHistoryDescription: Amounts deducted from your balance, such as consultant-funded expenses, in date order.
retainedResultHistoryDescription: Company share of paid invoices and manual income, minus company-funded expenses for this consultant, in date order.
fixedRetainedResultHistoryDescription: Paid invoice income minus expenses attributed to this consultant, in date order.
netIncomeHistoryDescription: Net income entries included in this selection, in date order.
companyRetainedResultHistoryDescription: Company net income minus company expenses, in date order.
dateFormatError: Enter the date as yyyy-mm-dd, for example 2026-10-03.
typeTip: Income is money the company receives. Expense is money that is paid out.
categoryTip: The bookkeeping category. The list depends on the type you choose.
consultantTip: The consultant this entry belongs to, or Company only when it is the company's own.
dateTip: The invoice or purchase date. It decides which month and VAT period the entry belongs to.
amountEntryModeTip: Choose which amounts you type in. With net and VAT, both are saved exactly as on the receipt.
totalAmountSekTip: The amount to pay, including VAT and any rounding.
vatAmountSekTip: The VAT amount exactly as printed on the receipt or invoice.
roundingSekTip: Rounding to whole kronor printed on the receipt, plus or minus, such as -0.25. It only changes the total.
fundingTip: Who paid. For consultants with an invoice share, an expense paid by the consultant is deducted from their balance. For fixed salary + invoice share, book the fixed salary as paid by the company and share payouts as paid by the consultant.
applyConsultantShareTip: Credits the consultant with their agreed share of the net amount. Only for compensation with an invoice share.
consultantDescriptionTip: Shown to the consultant in their finance view.
internalNoteTip: Only visible to admins and accountants, never to the consultant.
invoiceNumberTip: Suggested from the next invoice number in the company's invoice details. Change it if needed; it must be unique.
periodFromTip: Optional. The first day of the period the invoice is for, for example the first day of the month the work was done.
periodToTip: Optional. The last day of the period the invoice is for. Fill in both dates or neither.
customerTip: The customer the invoice is addressed to.
invoiceConsultantTip: The consultant who did the work, or Company only when no consultant is involved. Decides how the payment is split.
issueDateTip: The invoice date. It decides the consultant's compensation agreement and the VAT period.
dueDateTip: The last day for the customer to pay. It cannot be before the invoice date.
shareOverrideTip: Optional. Replaces the consultant's agreed share for this invoice only. Only for compensation with an invoice share.
transactionShareOverrideTip: Optional. Replaces the consultant's agreed share for this income only. Use 100 to credit the full net amount, for example when returning money the consultant already paid.
vatPaymentDateTip: The day the VAT was paid to the tax account. AI uses the due date when the file shows no payment.
vatPaymentAmountTip: The VAT paid to Skatteverket (Moms att betala). It cannot be more than the VAT currently payable.
vatPeriodFromTip: The first day of the VAT reporting period, for example 2026-04-01 for April - June.
vatPeriodToTip: The last day of the VAT reporting period, for example 2026-06-30 for April - June.
paymentReferenceTip: The OCR or reference number used for the payment.
vatRoundingTip: Optional. Skatteverket declares VAT in whole kronor, so the VAT in the books can differ by some öre. Enter that difference, plus or minus, such as 0.37, to settle it without paying it.
vatNoteTip: Only visible to admins and accountants.
financeCorrectionReason: Correction entered by an administrator or accountant.

mfaChallengeBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for Debageri Portal.
mfaRequiredBody: The portal contains sensitive financial information, so every account must now be protected with two-factor authentication. Install an authenticator app on your phone, scan the QR code below and enter the code from the app. You only need to do this once.

mfaEnrolledSignInAgain: Two-factor authentication is now active. Sign in again and enter a code from the app.

mfaResetDone: Two-factor login was reset for {name}. They will set it up again at their next sign-in.
mfaResetFailed: Two-factor login could not be reset. Please try again.

receiptError_invalidInput: Check the name, date, amounts and description and try again.

aiLeaveBlankApiKey: Leave blank to keep the existing key

aiFeatureHelp_financeIncomingEmails: Reads emails forwarded to the finance mailbox from trusted senders, recognizes whether each is an income, an expense or an invoice and prepares it for approval under Finance › Incoming financial emails.

aiVatDiffers: The document states VAT {vat}, which differs slightly from the calculated VAT. Adjust if needed.

aiError_aiUnsupportedFile: This file type cannot be read with AI.

aiError_aiNoResult: The AI could not read this file.
aiError_attachmentTooLarge: The file is too large to process.
selectConsultantError: Please select a consultant, or Company only.

incomingFinancialEmailsDescription: Receipts and invoices forwarded to the finance mailbox. Check what AI read from each email and turn it into an income, an expense or an invoice with a few clicks.
incomingEmailSettingsDescription: Forward receipts and invoices to a dedicated mailbox. The portal reads it every hour from 08:00 to 23:00, or straight away with Read now under Finance. Only emails from the trusted senders below are read; their text and attachments are kept for further processing, and nothing is booked until someone approves it.
incomingEmailAiOff: Incoming emails are only read when AI integration is on and “Finance: Process incoming financial emails” is ticked under its sections.
incomingEmailMailboxOff: The finance mailbox is not set up or is switched off.
imapHostTip: The server the portal reads mail from, such as imap.gmail.com or outlook.office365.com. Incoming mail is read over IMAP, not SMTP.
imapPasswordTip: Use an app password when the mail provider offers one. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
imapFolderTip: The folder to read, usually INBOX.
imapSecureTip: Connect with TLS from the start, which port 993 expects. Untick only for servers that upgrade the connection with STARTTLS.
incomingEmailEnabledTip: When ticked, the mailbox is read every hour from 08:00 to 23:00 and with Read now. Read messages are marked as read in the mailbox.
incomingEmailTestSucceeded: The portal could sign in and open the folder.
incomingEmailTestFailed: The mailbox could not be reached.
incomingEmailError_mailboxAuthFailed: The mail server did not accept the username or password.
incomingEmailError_mailboxFolderMissing: The folder does not exist in this mailbox.
incomingEmailError_mailboxConnectionFail: The mail server could not be reached. Check the server, port and TLS setting.
incomingEmailError_incomingEmailBusy: The mailbox is already being read. Try again in a moment.
incomingEmailError_incomingEmailDisabled: Reading incoming emails is switched off.
incomingEmailTrustedSendersDescription: Only emails from these addresses are processed. Add the addresses you forward receipts and invoices from; mail from anyone else is left unread by the portal.
incomingEmailNoTrustedSenders: No trusted senders yet, so no emails will be processed.
incomingEmailSenderDuplicate: Each address can only be added once.
incomingEmailSaveFailed: The incoming email settings could not be saved.
incomingEmailReadSummary: Read {read} emails: {stored} ready for review, {failed} need attention, {skipped} skipped.
incomingEmailSkipped_untrustedSender: {count} came from a sender that is not on the trusted list in Email settings.
incomingEmailSkipped_senderCheckFailed: {count} failed the sender check (DMARC), so the sender may be forged.
incomingEmailSkipped_unreadable: {count} could not be downloaded from the mailbox.
incomingEmailReadFailed: The mailbox could not be read.
incomingEmailLoadFailed: The emails could not be loaded.
incomingEmailFailedNotice: AI could not read this email: {reason} You can try again or create the record and fill it in yourself.
incomingEmailNoAttachments: The email had no attachments that can be kept.
incomingEmailDismissText: It moves to Dismissed and is not booked. You can restore it later.
incomingEmailActionFailed: The email could not be updated.
incomingEmailFormNotice: Filled in from the email “{subject}” from {from}.
incomingEmailFormCheck: Check the values and the attached files before saving. Saving marks the email as created.
incomingEmailFilesFailed: The email's files could not be attached. Download them from the email and add them by hand.
accountingEmailsDescription: Email addresses of your accountant or accounting firm. After income, expenses, invoices or VAT payments are saved, the portal can email the details and files to the addresses chosen for that kind of change.
accountingEmailsSmtpMissing: Emails are sent with the organization's email settings, which are not set up yet.
accountingContactNameTip: A name for this address, used as the recipient name in emails.
accountingContactEmailTip: The email address that receives the details and files.
accountingContactLanguageTip: The language of the emails sent to this address.
accountingEmailsSaveFailed: The accounting emails could not be saved. Check the names and email addresses.
accountingEmailDuplicate: Each email address can only be added once.
sendToAccountingText: Email the details of this {entity} and its files to:
accountingSendError_noRecipients: No accounting email is chosen for this kind of change.
accountingSendError_emailNotConfigured: Email settings are not set up, so nothing could be sent.
accountingSendError_sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Check the email settings and try again.
accountingSendError_failed: The email could not be sent.
placeholderHelp_employeeName: Name of the person who has missing time reports
placeholderHelp_missingWeeks: The weeks that have not been reported
placeholderHelp_recipientName: Name of the person receiving the email
placeholderHelp_link: Link to the related page in the portal
placeholderHelp_personName: Name of the person who submitted the receipt
placeholderHelp_commentLine: A "Comment: …" line, only when there is a comment
placeholderHelp_details: All details of the entry, one per line
placeholderHelp_entity: "income" or "expense" in lower case, for use within a sentence
placeholderHelp_date: Date of the income or expense
placeholderHelp_consultant: Name of the consultant, if any
placeholderHelp_period: Period the invoice covers, if any
copiedEntriesReady: Copied entries are ready. Review, save and submit when finished.
timesheetAttachmentsHelp: Optional. Add for example a screenshot from your client's time reporting system or a PDF showing that your client's manager approved your time. PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each and 3 files per report. You can add files when submitting or later. You can remove a file until the report is submitted; after that only a manager or admin can remove it.
timesheetAttachmentsOnSubmit: These files are added when you submit the report.
removeTimesheetAttachmentDescription: {name} will be permanently removed from this time report.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentRequi: Choose a file that is not empty.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentTooLa: A file can be at most 5 MB.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentType: Only PDF, JPG, PNG and WebP files can be added.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentLimit: A time report can have at most 3 files.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentUploa: The file could not be added. Please try again.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentLoadF: The files could not be loaded.
timesheetAttachmentError_attachmentRemov: The file could not be removed. Please try again.
timesheetAttachmentError_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
timesheetAttachmentError_notFound: The file or time report no longer exists.
reportTimeDescription: Choose a reporting period, enter hours by time code and review the report before submitting it for approval.
reportingWeekModeLabel: Choose how to select a reporting week
chooseDateInWeek: Choose any date in the week
fullWeekOpensAutomatically: The full Monday to Sunday week opens automatically.
timesheetSaveRetry: The time report could not be saved. Please try again.
timesheetLoadFailed: The time report could not be loaded.
timesheetSubmitRetry: The report could not be submitted. Please try again. Your draft is still saved.
timesheetDeleteFailed: Could not delete the time report.
zeroHoursFailed: The zero-hour report could not be created.
zeroHoursRetry: The zero-hour report could not be created. Please try again.
warningRedDay: Time is reported on 1 red day.
warningRedDays: Time is reported on {count} red days.
warningOver40Hours: Total reported time exceeds 40 hours for this week.
warningFutureDates: You are reporting time on future dates!
reviewWarningsDescription: Please review the unusual reporting conditions before continuing.
nonWorkingTitle: This week has only non-working days
nonWorkingQuestion: Would you like to report 0 working hours? The report will be approved automatically and will not require manager review. Select No if you worked on one of these red days and need to enter working time.
deleteReportDescription: This report ({status}) and its entries will be permanently removed.
myReportedTimeDescription: Understand how your submitted time is distributed across work and absence categories.
timesheetError_notFound: The time report was not found.
timesheetError_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
timesheetError_operationFailed: The operation could not be completed.
timesheetError_weekNotFound: The selected ISO week does not exist.
timesheetError_weekPartNotFound: The selected week part does not exist.
timesheetError_copyWeekNotFound: The copy-from week does not exist.
timesheetError_alreadyReported: You already reported this week. Delete the existing draft if you want to report again, or edit that draft.
timesheetError_afterEmploymentEnd: Time cannot be reported after the employment end date.
timesheetError_zeroHourEntries: A zero-hour report cannot contain time entries.
timesheetError_confirmZeroHours: This period contains only non-working days. Confirm reporting 0 hours to continue.
timesheetError_invalidEntryDateOrCode: An entry contains an invalid date or time code.
timesheetError_redDayNeedsWorkCode: Only working-time codes can be reported on red or non-working days.
timesheetError_saveFailed: The time report could not be saved. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact an administrator.
timesheetError_deleteProtected: Only draft or submitted time reports can be deleted. Approved and rejected reports are protected.
timesheetError_confirmationRequired: Type "I am sure" to confirm deletion.
rejectedReportHint: Change the rows if needed and submit the report again.
copyWeekEmpty: Nothing to copy: week {week} has no reported time for these days.
warningResubmitUnchanged: This report was rejected. Are you sure you want to submit the same as before?
employeeTabIntro_compensation: Every compensation period for this person: past, current and upcoming.
employeeCompensationNotPaid: Tick Company will pay salary to add a monthly salary for this person.
employeeCompensationRoleNotPaid: Choose a role to set up compensation.
companyPaysSalaryTip: For staff the company pays every month, such as an accountant or HR. Their salary is an expense for the company and earns no invoice income.
requestedMonthlySalaryTip: The gross salary the consultant wants paid each month until further notice. It is paid from their balance, with employer contributions. Add a new period to change it.
financeError_compensationNotPaid: Tick Company will pay salary and save the employee before adding a salary.
noCompensationRecords: No compensation has been added yet.
employeeCompensationSaveRoleFirst: Save the role and the salary choice before adding compensation.
employeeCompensationSaveFailed: The employee was created, but the compensation could not be saved. Add it here.
financeError_compensationConfirmationReq: The current compensation period has no end date. Reload the page and confirm that it should end.
endCurrentCompensationExplanation: The current compensation, valid from {validFrom}, has no end date. Saving the new one will automatically set its valid to date to {validTo}.
monthlyCompensationTip: Fixed salary plus the invoice share credited that month. The share counts in the month the invoice is paid. The salary is not prorated.
accessProfilesDescription: Define what each group of people can see and do, then assign a profile to each employee.
accessProfileFormDescription: Tick what this profile may do. A permission always includes the view above it.
accessProfileAudienceTip: Consultant profiles can only grant a person's own data. Office staff profiles apply to managers and accountants.
accessProfileChangeWarning: People with this profile: {count}. Changes apply to them immediately.
employeeNeedsProfile: Choose an access profile before saving. Until then this person has no access.
accessProfileError_nameTaken: A profile with that name already exists.
accessProfileError_invalidInput: Check the profile details and try again.
accessProfileError_forbidden: You do not have access to do this.
accessProfileError_saveFailed: The profile could not be saved. Please try again.
accessProfileError_audienceLocked: This profile is in use, so who it is for cannot change.
accessProfileError_profileAssigned: This profile is assigned to people. Move them to another profile first.
accessProfileError_profileDefault: Default profiles cannot be deleted, but you can edit them.
accessProfileError_profileInvalid: That access profile does not fit this role.
permission_finance_invoices_edit: Edit invoices, including marking them paid
permissionTip_export: Hides the export buttons. Anyone who can view the list can still see its rows.
permissionTip_timeExport: Shows the Excel export button in the month and year views.
permission_finance_salary_book: Book salaries in income and expenses
permissionTip_finance_salary_view: Salary rows show personal identity numbers, addresses and pay. Give it only to people who run payroll.
permission_finance_incomingEmails_proces: Read now, approve and dismiss incoming emails
viewAsBar: You are viewing the portal as {name}. You see what they see, and changes are turned off.
viewAsEnded: This view has ended. Exit to get back to your own account.
viewAsExitFailed: The view could not be ended. Please try again.
viewAsPausedDescription: This browser now shows the portal as this person, in every tab. Exit the view to continue as yourself.
viewAsReadOnly: You are viewing the portal as someone else, so changes are turned off.
viewAsStartFailed: The view could not be started. Please try again.
invoiceSettingsEditDescription: The company details, bank account and numbering printed on the invoices the portal generates.
invoiceSettingsIncomplete: Invoices can't be generated until the name, address, org number, VAT number and bankgiro are filled in.
invoiceSettingsSaveFailed: The invoice details could not be saved. Check the marked fields.
invoiceSettingsError_orgNumberInvalid: Enter a valid organization number, for example 559555-8429.
invoiceSettingsError_vatNumberInvalid: Enter a Swedish VAT number, for example SE559555842901.
invoiceSettingsError_bankgiroInvalid: Enter a valid bankgiro number, for example 1234-5674.
invoiceSettingsError_bicInvalid: Enter a valid BIC with 8 or 11 characters.
invoiceSettingTip_paymentTermsDays: Days until the due date on new invoices, unless the customer has its own terms.
invoiceSettingTip_nextInvoiceNumber: Suggested on the next new invoice. Saving an invoice with a higher number moves it on. Continue from your last Fortnox invoice, for example 20.
invoiceSettingTip_nextCustomerNumber: Given to new customers that are saved without a customer number.
invoiceSettingTip_fSkatt: Prints "Godkänd för F-skatt" on the invoice.
invoiceSettingTip_ocrEnabled: Gives each invoice an OCR number made from the invoice number with a length and check digit. Ask your bank to turn on OCR for your bankgiro first.
invoicePdf_payWithOcr: Pay {amount} to bankgiro {bankgiro} by {dueDate}. Use OCR number {ocr} as the reference.
invoicePdf_payWithReference: Pay {amount} to bankgiro {bankgiro} by {dueDate}. Give invoice number {invoiceNumber} as the reference.
placeholderHelp_paymentReference: OCR number, or the invoice number when OCR is off
financeError_customerNumberDuplicate: Another customer already has this customer number.
financeError_invoiceAmountInvalid: The invoice total must be more than zero.
financeError_invoiceLocked: This invoice has been sent, paid or voided and can't be changed. Void it and create a new one instead.
financeError_invoiceSettingsIncomplete: Fill in the company's invoice details under Administration > Organization first.
financeError_customerAddressMissing: Add the customer's address before generating the invoice.
financeError_customerEmailMissing: The customer has no finance email to send the invoice to.
financeError_emailNotConfigured: Set up the email connection under Administration > Email settings first.
financeError_invoiceSendFailed: The invoice email could not be sent. Check the email settings and try again.
financeError_invoicePdfMissing: No PDF has been generated for this invoice yet.
customerNumberTip: Printed on the invoice. Leave blank to use the next customer number.
customerVatNumberTip: Needed for customers outside Sweden that pay VAT themselves (reverse charge).
defaultYourReferenceTip: Filled in as Your reference on new invoices, for example a purchase order or job number.
customerPaymentTermsDaysTip: Leave blank to use the company's default payment terms.
editInvoiceDescription: Correct the invoice before it is sent. Saving makes a new PDF the next time it is generated.
ourReferenceTip: Who the customer can contact about the invoice.
yourReferenceTip: The customer's reference, such as a purchase order or job number.
invoiceLinesIncomplete: Choose an article and enter a quantity on every row.
invoiceTextTip: Printed under the rows on the invoice, for example which month the hours are for.
invoiceHoursFillTip: Sets the quantity of the hourly article (unit h) to the consultant's approved worked hours in the period. Uses the hourly article on a row, or the consultant's own one.
invoiceHoursNeedPeriod: Choose a consultant and the period first.
invoiceHoursNone: There are no approved worked hours in this period.
invoiceHoursPending: Set {article} to {approved} approved hours. {pending} more hours in the period aren't approved yet and were left out.
invoiceSavedPdfFailed: The invoice was saved, but its PDF could not be generated.
sendInvoiceConfirm: Send invoice {number} as a PDF to {email}? After that it can't be edited, only voided.
sendInvoiceBccNote: A copy goes to {email} as BCC.
invoiceSentLockedTip: A sent invoice keeps the details it was sent with. To correct it, void it and create a new invoice.
voidInvoiceConfirm: Void invoice {number}? It stays in the list as void.
voidPaidInvoiceConfirm: Void invoice {number}? It's paid, so its income entries are reversed too.
invoicePdf_slipFee: Payment fee (filled in by the bank)
articlesSectionDescription: The articles invoices are made from, with their price, unit, VAT and the consultant they're for.
newArticleDescription: Define something you invoice, such as hours at a consultant's rate.
editArticleDescription: Changes apply to new and edited invoices; invoices already saved keep their rows.
noArticles: No articles match. Add one to pick it when you create an invoice.
articleNumberTip: Printed in the Art. no. column, for example 2. Two articles can share a number if they are for different consultants or periods.
articleDescriptionTip: The row text on the invoice, for example Timmar.
articleConsultantTip: Which invoices offer this article: all invoices, company-only invoices, or one consultant's invoices.
articleValidToTip: Leave empty while the article is in use. The invoice date decides which articles apply.
articlePriceInvalid: Enter the price in kronor, for example 850.00.
invoiceArticlesMixedVat: The chosen articles have different VAT rates. Put them on separate invoices.
invoiceArticleNotApplicableRow: A row's article isn't valid for this consultant or invoice date. Choose another article.
financeError_articleOverlap: Another article with this number and consultant is valid on some of the same days.
financeError_articleDatesInvalid: Valid to can't be before Valid from.
financeError_articleMissing: The article could not be found.
financeError_invoiceArticleNotApplicable: A row's article isn't valid for this consultant or invoice date.
financeError_invoiceArticleVatMismatch: The VAT rate must match the VAT of the articles on the invoice.
invoiceNoArticles: There are no invoice articles for this consultant on the invoice date. Add one first.
invoiceHoursNeedArticle: Choose an hourly article (unit h) on a row first. Fill from approved hours only sets its quantity.
aiNetForArticles: The file's amount excluding VAT is {amount}. Choose the articles and quantities for the rows.
generateInvoicePdfAttachTip: Makes the invoice PDF from the form as it is now, so you can look at it before saving. To make a new one, remove the attached PDF first. Saving stores it with the invoice, made from the saved details; it doesn't count toward the 3 files.
generatedInvoicePdfStale: The form has changed since the PDF was made. Saving makes it again from the saved details; to look at it first, remove it and generate it again.
invoiceLocked_paid: This invoice is paid, so its amounts, rows and dates can't be changed. You can still change the references, texts and notes, and add or remove files.
invoiceLocked_sent: This invoice has been sent to the customer, so it can't be changed. You can only add or remove files. To correct it, void it and create a new invoice.
invoiceLocked_void: This invoice is void, so it can't be changed. You can only add or remove files.
useInvoiceGeneratorTip: Build the invoice from articles and generate its PDF here. Leave it off when the invoice was made in another system; then enter its net amount and attach its file.
financeError_invoiceNotGenerated: This invoice wasn't made with the invoice generator, so the portal can't make or send its PDF.
employeeTabIntro_vacation: Yearly vacation days, the date the vacation year starts and the vacation pay supplement. New days are granted automatically on that date.
employeeTabIntro_payroll: How the tax deduction is worked out and where the salary is paid. Only administrators see these details.
personalNumberInvalid: Enter a valid personal identity number, for example 19900101-1234.
payrollNoTaxRates: No tax rates are imported yet, so the kommun list is empty. You can still enter the tax table by hand.
municipalityTip: Where the person is registered on 1 November the year before. The tax rates are from {year}.
churchMember: Member of the Church of Sweden
churchMemberTip: Members pay a church fee, which can move them to a higher tax table.
taxTableTip: The table number on the person's tax decision, such as 33. Choose a kommun to have it suggested.
taxTableSuggestedTip: Suggested from the kommun: table {table} for a total rate of {rate} %. Change it if the tax decision says otherwise.
taxColumnTip: Column 1 is for salary to people under 66. The other columns are for pensions and other income; Skatteverket's tables describe them.
taxAdjustmentTip: Use when Skatteverket has decided a different deduction. It replaces the table tax.
taxTablesDescription: Skatteverket's monthly tax tables and the tax rate of every kommun, used to work out preliminary tax on salaries.
taxTablesImportExplanation: Fetches the tables and the kommun tax rates for the year from Skatteverket's open data. Skatteverket publishes the next year's tables in December. Importing a year again replaces it.
taxTablesImported: Imported {tables} tax tables and {municipalities} kommuner for {year}.
taxTablesNotPublished: Skatteverket has not published tables for that year yet.
taxTablesUnavailable: Skatteverket's open data could not be reached. Try again in a while.
noTaxYears: No tax tables are imported yet.
vacationYearStartsTip: Each year on this day and month, unused days move to saved days and the new year's days are granted. The default is 1 April.
vacationDaysPerYearTip: Days for a full year of employment. Someone employed for part of the year gets a share, rounded up. A change applies from the next vacation year.
vacationSupplementTip: Semestertillägg: extra pay per vacation day as a percentage of the monthly salary, normally 0.8%. Advance days don't get it.
vacationOpeningNormalTip: Days left until the next vacation year starts, for example when moving from another system. New employees usually start at 0.
vacationAdvanceTip: Förskottssemester: paid days given before they are earned, usually in the first year. They are used after normal days and get no supplement.
vacationSaveFirst: Save the employee to start tracking vacation.
vacationLoadFailed: The vacation balance couldn't be loaded. Try again.
vacationNextRenewalRow: Next renewal: {days} days per year, pro-rated
vacationOverdrawn: More vacation is reported than this person has days for. Check the balance.
vacationAdjustDescription: Vacation year {start} – {end}. Enter what is left today; the change is logged.
vacationNotePlaceholder: Moved from the previous payroll system
vacationAdjustFailed: The balance couldn't be saved. Check the values and try again.
vacationNotTracked: Vacation isn't tracked for this person.
vacationSettingsLine: {days} days per year · supplement {percent}% per day
vacationPendingHint: in submitted weeks, not taken off yet
vacationInThisReport: This report includes {days} vacation days. They come off the balance below when you approve it.
vacationInThisReportUntracked: This report includes {hours} of vacation. Vacation isn't tracked for this person, so no balance is shown.
vacationOverdrawnOwn: You have reported more vacation than you have days for. Talk to your manager.
vacationOverdrawnReview: Approving this report uses more vacation than this person has days for.
financeError_salarySlipMissing: The salary row was not found.
financeError_salarySlipLocked: This salary row can no longer be changed this way.
financeError_salarySlipChanged: Someone else changed this salary row. Reload the page and try again.
financeError_salarySlipNotReady: Mark the salary row ready first.
financeError_payrollProfileMissing: Add the personal identity number, address and tax table on the employee first.
financeError_taxTableMissing: Import the tax tables for the payment year first.
financeError_payslipExists: A payslip is already uploaded for this person and month.
financeError_salarySlipNotBookable: Generate the payslip before booking the salary.
payslipError_payslipBooked: This payslip belongs to a booked salary. Reverse the booking before deleting it.
financeError_salaryCategoryMissing: The salary, salary tax or employer contributions category is deactivated. Reactivate it under Categories.
financeError_transactionSalaryLinked: Salary entries are changed from their salary row under Salaries.
salariesDescription: Prepare each month's salaries, publish the payslips and book them in income and expenses.
generateSalaryExplanation: Creates a salary row for everyone the company pays this month. Running it again adds anyone missing and rebuilds rows not yet ready, keeping lines added by hand.
salaryEventsTip: Vacation, sick days and leave in this period come from approved time reports. Usually the month before the payment.
noSalaryRows: No salary rows yet for this month.
salaryRowsGenerated: Salary rows are up to date.
salaryPayslipsGenerated: Payslips generated and published to Pay slips.
salariesBooked: Salaries booked in income and expenses.
salaryBalanceShort: {name}'s balance ({balance}) does not cover gross pay plus employer contributions ({needed}).
salaryBalanceInfo: Balance before this salary: {balance}. The salary and employer contributions are paid from it.
replacePayslipExplanation: A payslip was already uploaded for at least one of these people and months. Replacing it removes the uploaded file.
bookSalariesExplanation: Each expense gets the person's payslip attached, the same file as in their Pay slips.
bookSalariesNetTip: Books the payout. Record the withheld tax yourself when it is paid to Skatteverket.
bookSalariesNetPlusTaxTip: Books the payout as salary and the withheld tax as salary tax; together they make the gross pay.
bookEmployerFeeTip: Arbetsgivaravgifter on gross pay and benefits. The standard rate is 31.42 %; younger and older employees can have lower rates.
addSalaryLineTip: Choose payment or deduction, how it is taxed and what it is for. Type the price without a minus sign.
salaryLinesInvalid: Check the numbers in the lines and the tax.
salaryTaxAdjusted: Tax from the jämkning decision on the employee.
salaryTypeTaxTip: Replaces the table tax for this salary, for example when Skatteverket's tax decision differs.
reverseSalaryExplanation: Its expenses get linked reversals and the row opens for changes. The payslip stays until a new one is generated.
salaryProblemHelp_payrollProfileMissing: Add the personal identity number, address and tax table on the employee, then update the salary rows. You can also enter the tax amount manually.
salaryProblemHelp_taxTableMissing: Import the tax tables for the payment year, then update the salary rows. You can also enter the tax amount manually.
removeSalaryRowExplanation: Their row is removed and they are not paid this month. Updating the salary rows leaves them out until you choose them again.
salaryNoCandidates: Nobody has a salary agreement for this month.
salaryPersonLocked: Their salary is already ready or further along. Reopen it to change it.
salaryUseTimeReportsTip: Vacation adds a supplement and leave and sick days make deductions. Turn it off to pay the full monthly salary whatever was reported.
salaryTimeReportsIgnored: Time reports are not used for this salary.
salaryNoTimeReports: There are no approved time reports from {eventFrom} – {eventTo}, so the full monthly salary is paid and no vacation or leave is taken into account.
salaryScopeTip: The share of the line that applies (omfattning), usually 100 %. Use 50 % for half-time pay or when only part of a period counts; the amount is quantity × price × scope.
salaryOneTimeTip: Bonuses, commission, retroactive pay and similar payments are taxed apart from the monthly salary, with Skatteverket's table for one-time payments. The percent depends on the expected annual income: this month's regular pay times 12 plus this year's one-time payments. Without a monthly salary it is 30 %.
salaryProblemHelp_oneTimeTaxTableMissing: The portal has no table for one-time payments for the payment year yet. Enter the tax amount manually.
financeError_oneTimeTaxTableMissing: There is no table for one-time payments for the payment year. Enter the tax amount manually.
